name: MSC GeoMet OGC API (Environment Canada)

provider.name: Environment and Climate Change Canada, Meteorological Service of Canada

summary: Canada's official weather, climate, hydrometric and air-quality data as an OGC API (Features) served as GeoJSON, free and keyless.
description: The MSC GeoMet-OGC-API exposes more than 100 collections at the time of checking: climate stations, daily, monthly and hourly climate observations, climate normals, hydrometric stations and real-time water levels and flows, city page weather, marine weather, real-time surface observations (SWOB), air quality health index observations and forecasts, hurricane tracks and more. Collections are queried with standard OGC API Features parameters.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented on the pages fetched.

endpoints.summary: Query features of a collection (OGC API Features)

license.name: Environment and Climate Change Canada Data Server End-use Licence

coverage.geographic: Canada (some collections include nearby marine and international areas)
coverage.temporal: Varies: real-time feeds and historical climate records from the 1800s onward in some collections

agent_notes: Start with /collections?f=json to see the ids, then /collections/{id}/queryables for filterable properties. Use f=json (GeoJSON) or f=csv. Page with limit and offset (follow the next link in the response). Climate daily data is queried with CLIMATE_IDENTIFIER and datetime, e.g. climate-daily?CLIMATE_IDENTIFIER=6158355&sortby=-LOCAL_DATE.
caveats: Observed: climate-stations LATITUDE and LONGITUDE are integers in 1e-7 degrees-style units (485500000); use the GeoJSON geometry for coordinates.
The newest daily climate rows can have null values until quality control completes.
Rate limits and CORS beyond the example endpoint were not individually confirmed.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key; the OpenAPI URL returned openapi 3.0.2.
